title: ESPN predicts the final score of Wisconsin vs. Rutgers in Week 10
text:
ESPN predicts the final score of Wisconsin vs. Rutgers in Week 10 Schedule Football Basketball Recruiting Big Ten Sports Newsletter FOOTBALL ESPN predicts the final score of Wisconsin vs. Rutgers in Week 10
 Connor Mardian Badgers Wire Updated Nov. 4, 2026, 3:56 p.m. CT The Wisconsin Badgers still have every chance to finish the 2026 campaign with a stellar record, perhaps the best under head coach Luke Fickell .
 That being said, things have to change if the Badgers want to progress toward eight or nine wins under the man who took Cincinnati to the College Football Playoffs. 
 Right now, the Badgers hold a 5-3 record, with games against Rutgers, Maryland, Purdue, and Minnesota still left on the schedule. 
 While there is no easy game in the Big Ten, this week's matchup against Rutgers will probably serve as the season’s final easy test as the Scarlett Knights sit at just 2-6 with wins against only Howard and Maryland.
 However, it isn’t just the public that thinks this could be an easier matchup; ESPN's Bill Connelly’s SP+ metric is a widely accepted figure that covers several different permutations across collegiate football.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Connelly’s SP+ predicts a 33-18 Badgers win, giving Fickell’s team an 83% chance of walking away winners, securing just the second bowl game in Fickell’s tenure. 
 The two sides have met six times since 2014, and in those six games, the Badgers are undefeated, allowing more than 10 points only once, in 2018.
 The last time the pair met was in 2024, and it resulted in a 42-7 blowout.
